brief: Holds an API key as a secret that is redacted everywhere and is presented as a bearer Authorization header only to an effectful actor.
detail: A stzSecret of kind apikey. Its descriptor, its Show and any configuration it lands in print only the redacted form. AuthorizationHeader is a governed reveal: a human or pi actor gets Bearer followed by the key, an LLM actor or an unknown actor is refused. Use invented values in code and tests.
